scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I submitted a housing loan application recently and was hoping to get an update on its status. Is it still pending, or has a decision been made?
dialogue.agent: The action taken on your VA home purchase loan application, loan ID LOAN-01014, was 'Loan originated'.

dialogue.user: Oh, that's wonderful news! So, it was approved? Can you tell me what the interest rate is on this loan and what the total costs will be?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan was approved. The interest rate for your loan is 7.250%, and the total loan costs are $8,341.61.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. I have a few more questions. What is the loan term, and are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The loan term is 360 months. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: That's a relief! One last question: has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user:
Okay, thank you for clarifying all of that. I think I have all the information I need.

<Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the interaction because the agent was able to answer all my questions clearly and promptly.
